tools.name: search_tours

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Open departure times and booking status for one tour on one date, from the American Ghost Walks booking system. Times are local to the tour. Check this before telling a guest a time is open; if it says availability is unknown or lists no times, send the guest to the booking link instead of guessing.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns the official American Ghost Walks booking link for a tour, plus what to pick on its calendar. The guest chooses the date, time and tickets and pays on that page; this tool does not reserve or charge anything. Share the returned URL exactly as given.

tools.name: get_tour_details
tools.description: Full details for one tour: description, stops, meeting spot with map link, duration, difficulty, FAQ, important info, cancellation/weather/age/pet policies and rating. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_link · Public sink: get_availability, get_booking_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_link · Public sink: get_availability, get_booking_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
